$comment: Canonical guarded-command policy. Rendered into per-agent hook configs and the AGENTS.md Guarded commands table by pnpm ai:install. `command` prefix-matches a shell segment; `flag` must appear as a whitespace-delimited token in that segment. `deny` is enforced on every agent that honours a blocking hook; `ask` is a three-state verdict on Claude and Cursor and degrades to an advisory elsewhere, so anything irreversible belongs in `deny`.

rules.reason: Unrestricted schema push can drop columns in DATABASE_URL. Shared and deployed databases require pnpm db:generate and reviewed migrations. The local wrapper requires explicit opt-in and validates loopback PostgreSQL.
Removes every node_modules directory in the tree.
Moves release/<app> branches, which triggers deploys. The Release workflow owns this on main after merge.
Bypasses commitlint, the AI-attribution gate, and the pre-push typecheck. Fix the hook failure instead of skipping it.
Rewrites the seed user's credential row in whatever DATABASE_URL points at.
Applies migrations to whatever DATABASE_URL points at.
Wraps clean-deps and reinstalls the whole workspace.
Destructive on a shared branch. kaine-rebase needs it, so it asks rather than denies. --force-with-lease is unaffected.
kaine-open-pr creates drafts; merging is a human decision.
